dataset_title: Product composition and process-context observations for perennial-ryegrass green protein concentrate
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0); article is marked open access, and MDPI's current rights page states articles use CC BY 4.0 unless an exception is stated.
source_material: Fresh perennial ryegrass (Lolium perenne) processed by the Grassa BV green-biorefinery process
process_description: Mechanical extrusion produced press cake and green juice.
The press cake was reported to contain approximately 50-60% of original, primarily insoluble protein; the remaining approximate 40-50% was pressed into green juice.
Protein in green juice was heat-coagulated in heat exchangers and separated by vacuum filtration.
The concentrate used in the feed trial was dried by belt dryer to approximately 90% dry matter.
data_handling: Reported product percentages, range values, qualitative starch statement, approximate dry-matter endpoint, gross energy, and approximate process protein partition were transcribed without unit conversion or midpoint imputation. Table 6 states that figures are g per 100 g of feed; Results 3.1 does not make the moisture basis of proximate values explicit. Table 4 amino-acid values were not transcribed because the table's denominator was not unambiguously established from the available source text. The two approximate protein-partition ranges are separate prose statements and are not forced into a closed mass balance.
limitations: Feedstock is cultivated perennial ryegrass, not Dutch roadside grass.
Grassa process details are proprietary; the source gives no complete stream masses or component balance.
The basis of the proximate-analysis percentages in Results 3.1 and gross-energy value is not specified there; do not convert them to dry-matter basis.
No replicate-level data, standard deviations, detection limit for starch, acid demand, dryer operating temperatures, dryer energy, or powder particle-size distribution are reported in this extract.
The approximately 50-60% and 40-50% protein partition figures are textual process estimates, not validated GreenHub recovery fractions; do not combine them as exact paired fractions.
No product grade, regulatory approval, sale price, or GreenHub route product specification is established.
suggested_use: Phase 4 reference-only comparator for grass-protein product composition, approximate product dry matter, and process boundary. Not a GreenHub default, mass-balance closure, dryer energy input, protein-recovery factor, or market-price basis.
